briefdescription.para: Tries to acquire the write lock.

simplesect.para: true, if lock is acquired successfully.
false, if failed to acquire the lock.

briefdescription.para: Tries to acquire the read lock.

simplesect.para: true, if lock is acquired successfully.
false, if failed to acquire the lock.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if a writer has acquired the lock, or waiting on the readers to release it.

simplesect.para: true a writer has acquired or waiting on readers to release the lock.
false the lock is not acquired by a writer.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if the lock is acquired by readers.

simplesect.para: true if the lock is acquired by readers.
false if the lock is not acquired by readers.

briefdescription.para: Write-preferring rwlock based on semaphore and an atomic vbool_t.

detaileddescription.para: When acquiring a read lock, wait for writers and then reserve one resource. When acquiring a write lock, lock writer bit and reserve all N resources.
